# Working Agreements

## General Approach

- Prefer the simplest solution that works.
- Make the smallest possible change to solve the problem.
- Avoid overengineering or speculative abstractions.

## Code Changes

- Modify as few files as possible.
- Do not refactor unrelated code.
- Preserve existing patterns unless there is a clear issue.

## Dependencies

- Do not introduce new dependencies unless absolutely necessary.
- Prefer built-in or existing utilities.

## Readability

- Use clear, explicit naming over cleverness.
- Optimize for someone reading the code for the first time.
- Always put styleSheet at bottom of file.

## Scope Control

- Stay focused on the task.
- Do not add extra features or “nice-to-haves” unless asked.
